Job Summary:

We are at the forefront of innovation, and we are seeking a brilliant Generative AI/LLM Engineer to join our team.
In this role, you will design, build, and deploy cutting-edge solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs).
You will explore and implement state-of-the-art AI techniques, create prototypes, and build products that solve real-world problems.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a passionate AI engineer to be on the cutting edge of technology.

Key Responsibilities :

- Design, develop, and deploy applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Fine-tune and prompt-engineer LLMs for specific business use cases.
- Experiment with and evaluate new AI models and frameworks.
- Build robust data pipelines to feed AI models.
- Collaborate with product managers and engineers to integrate AI solutions into products.
- Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning.

Required Qualifications:

- Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in AI and machine learning.
- Strong experience with Generative AI and LLMs (e.g., GPT, Llama, Falcon).
- Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
- Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning techniques.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with cloud AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems.
- Experience with MLOps and deploying models to production.

Key Competencies:

- Innovation: Passion for exploring new AI technologies and applying them to real-world problems.
- Problem-Solving: Strong ability to design and build complex AI systems.
- Research Orientation: Keeps up-to-date with the latest AI research.
- Collaboration: Works effectively in a cross-functional team.

Summary

We are a cutting-edge Generative AI Center of Excellence (CoE) driving an innovation in life sciences through intelligent solutions. Our engineering team builds scalable platforms and accelerators that power AI-driven capabilities and products. Join us to shape the future of AI in healthcare and experience how impactful engineering drives real-world change.

About the Role

Responsibilities may include:

Collaborating with AI engineers and product teams to build and integrate GenAI applications
Developing APIs, microservices, and data pipelines for AI workloads
Optimizing performance, scalability, and security of AI-driven systems
Contributing to platform engineering using tools like Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud (Azure/AWS)
Supporting integration with LLMs, vector databases, and prompt engineering workflows
Participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and demo sessions

Preferred Skills and Technologies:

Strong programming in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript
Understanding of REST APIs, Microservices, and basic DevOps concepts
Familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs (e.g., GPT, LLaMA), or LangChain / RAG
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) or tools like Docker and GitHub Actions
Comfort with basic ML/NLP concepts is a bonus

Minimum Requirements:

Final-year or pre-final year student in Computer Science / IT / ECE / Data Science / AI/ML
Strong logical thinking, problem-solving, and curiosity for GenAI technologies
Ability to learn quickly and work in an agile, team-oriented environment
Passion for applying technology to real-world use cases in healthcare and pharma

Role: AI Engineer (5+ Years Experience)

Location: Pune, Maharashtra


Working Hours: US EST Time Zone 6:30 pm to 3:30 am IST

Experience Required: 5+ Years Relevant Experience


Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred (Maximum 30 Days Notice Period)




About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Engineer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML solutions, with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning frameworks, and cloud-based AI platforms. This role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams and alignment with US-based stakeholders during EST working hours.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML solutions for business-critical applications.
Build and optimize Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Develop and maintain end-to-end machine learning pipelines, including data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
Fine-tune and customize foundation models for specific business use cases.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and vector database solutions.
Integrate AI solutions with existing enterprise applications and APIs.
Monitor model performance, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve AI systems.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices.
Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and responsible AI standards.



Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
5+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering and solution development.
Strong proficiency in Python and AI/ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face.
Experience working with Large Language Models (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, Gemini, etc.).
Hands-on experience with RAG frameworks, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, etc.), and prompt engineering.
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their AI services.
Experience building and deploying scalable AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices architecture, and software engineering best practices.
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design principles.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AI agents, autonomous workflows, and multi-agent systems.
Exposure to MLOps tools and frameworks.
Experience in enterprise AI deployments and production-grade systems.
Knowledge of model evaluation, AI governance, and responsible AI practices.
Experience working with distributed teams and US-based clients.



What We Offer

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and Generative AI initiatives.
Exposure to global clients and challenging business problems.
Collaborative and innovation-driven work environment.
Career growth opportunities in a rapidly evolving AI ecosystem.

Business Unit Intro

Our team of 200 colleagues is at the heart of The Economist Groups digital-first agenda. Together, we are delivering user-friendly, high-quality digital products that bring data, intelligence and analysis to our growing global audiences across all our four businesses.

Our team develops cutting-edge products that provide valuable insights and analysis to business and government leaders worldwide. Whether it involves creating new products for the Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU), conceptualising mobile applications that deliver personalised content, or enhancing our flagship website, economist.com, the Technology team plays a crucial role in shaping how we attract, convert, engage, and retain our 1.2 million subscribers.

The Technology team collaborates closely with other teams to engineer innovative solutions that cater to the evolving needs of our subscribers. This includes leveraging advanced technologies and methodologies to enhance the acquisition of new subscribers, optimise conversion rates, deliver engaging user experiences, and ensure long-term subscriber loyalty.

Job Description

The role:

We are looking for a Natural Language Processing (NLP) Engineer to join our Economist Group engineering team. Your primary focus will be to design, develop, ship, maintain and oversee the relevant architecture of our Economist.com and EIU platforms - with a focus on systems related to our customer facing products. The initial focus will be around implementing appropriate data infrastructure required to enable predictive analytics, ML algorithms, and Generative AI applications, and in conjunction with the Head of AI and Data Engineering support the organisation to implement their vision. You’ll also work with individuals from our corporate data team (responsible for reporting, analytics and insights), as well as work collaboratively with data scientists and analysts in other teams across the organisation.

The role will suit either a mid-level NLP Engineer, or even an AI or ML Engineer ready for their next challenge, but with at least some experience leading or mentoring a high performing team. You should enjoy working with autonomy in a creative and entrepreneurial environment, and have a strong commitment to producing high quality solutions. We offer flexible working and have recently shifted to a 'remote first' working policy with a minimum expectation of coming to the office two days a month, however you can come in more often if you wish to.

How you will contribute in this role:

Architecting, building and maintaining NLP processing pipelines / workflows in Python via technologies such as serverless functions, Airflow, MLflow, or other.
Working with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to automate experiments that bring ML and NLP research ideas to production.
Fine Tuning and consuming Large Language Models (LLM) directly or via third party Generative AI API services.
Setting up Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, prompt engineering, and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) processes.
Implement MLOps and related DevOps focused on LLMs deployed in cloud-native environments.
Support, optimise and transition our current processes to ensure well architected implementations and best practices.
Work in an agile environment within a collaborative agile product team using Kanban
Collaborate across departments and work closely with data science teams and with business (economists/data) analysts in refining their data requirements for various initiatives and data consumption requirements.
Participate in designing and building NLP pipelining and choosing data processing techniques, which make it easier for them to integrate and consume data needed for various use cases.
Participate in ensuring compliance and governance during model use, to ensure that the users and consumers use the resources provisioned to them responsibly through data governance and compliance initiatives.

What we’re looking for:

6+ years of professional experience with atleast 4 years in NLP used in large scale digital applications.
Extensive experience with programming in Python and Jupyter notebooks.
Professional experience of designing, building and managing bespoke NLP solutions in cloud environments.
Experience in building NLP solutions while consuming LLMs, either directly from third party APIs or directly from repositories such as Hugging Face.
Fundamental technical expertise in cloud-native technologies, such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SageMaker Studio, Amazon ECR, Cloud Formation, or equivalent.
Experience in leading / mentoring NLP / ML engineering teams.
Familiarity in working in teams with data scientists and data engineers, for building automated pipelines for model building, deployment and monitoring.
An advanced degree in computer science, information science, data science, linguistics, or a related quantitative field or equivalent work experience.
Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to work well with a wide range of stakeholders.
Strong ownership, scrappy and biassed for action.

AI usage for your application

We are an innovative organisation that encourages the use of technology. We recognise that candidates may utilise AI tools to support with their job application process. However, it is essential that all information you provide truthfully and accurately reflects your own experience, skills, and qualifications.

We are hiring a Gen AI Data Scientist with strong expertise in Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs). The candidate will work on developing AI-powered intelligent solutions, enterprise GenAI applications, and advanced analytics use cases.




Roles and Responsibilities


Build and deploy Generative AI and Machine Learning solutions.

jobs.job_title: Senior Systems Engineer - Mainframe Modernization & GenAI
jobs.job_description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
AIA Mainframe Modernization Specialist
The opportunity
We are seeking a skilled Senior Mainframe Modernization Specialist to join our AI-Driven Modernization practice, focused on transforming legacy mainframe systems into agile, efficient, and cloud-ready platforms. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of mainframe expertise, AI tools proficiency, and cloud technologies along with hands-on collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable modernization outcomes.
You will work closely with technology leads, architects, and business stakeholders to analyse legacy applications, leverage AI/ML to automate code analysis and refactoring, and execute migration of mainframe workloads to modern distributed and cloud-native platforms.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence:
Mainframe Systems Analysis and Understanding
Assess and analyse existing mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS) to identify modernization opportunities and dependencies.
Document current-state architecture, data flows, batch schedules, and integration points across legacy ecosystem components.
Perform impact analysis and complexity assessment for potential transitions to modern platforms.
AI-Driven Mainframe Modernization
Apply AI tools and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and technical debt reduction.
Develop and fine-tune AI-powered assistants to accelerate system conversion and code translation (e.g., COBOL to Java/Python).
Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to maximise accuracy and efficiency of LLM-driven modernization workflows.
Modernization Execution
Execute modernization tasks including rehosting, refactoring, or rebuilding mainframe workloads based on defined strategies.
Participate in the design and implementation of target-state architectures aligned with cloud-native and microservices patterns.
Ensure code quality, testability, and maintainability throughout the modernization lifecycle.
API and Microservices Development
Contribute to the design and development of API integrations and microservices to replace or wrap legacy mainframe functionality.
Implement RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, and integration patterns as part of the target-state solution.
Cloud and Platform Integration
Support migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI-driven solutions.
Integrate modernized components with cloud-native services, containerised workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.
Documentation and Reporting
Create and maintain technical documentation including system designs, migration runbooks, and AI pipeline configurations.
Provide regular status updates on modernization progress, risks, and deliverables to project leads.
Skills and Attributes:
Educational Background
B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Professional Experience
5 to 9 years of hands-on experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM).
Experience with data migration, integration, ETL processes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as Python and/or Java.
Working knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
Hands-on experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
Experience with mainframe modernization tools or platforms (e.g., Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate) is a plus.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation and presentations.
Preferred Certifications
Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), AI/ML certifications, or mainframe-related certifications are a plus.
Why Join Us
Be at the forefront of AI-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
Work with global teams to drive real business impact through digital transformation.
Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and technology leaders in a highly innovative environment.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.
Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
